data.q: Executive and board approval of the commercial model: approved, or changes requested?

First client AdvancedMD: platform, data and access route, compliance approver
AdvancedMD: developer agreement fees and certification time; can GeBBS work through each client's licence?
Weekly intake: how do the files to process arrive (email batch, upload, system export)? If a system, can it feed the intake workflow directly?
Human baseline today: analysts per client, lines per analyst per day, QA accuracy
Hosting and data residency: UnifyApps cloud, GeBBS or client environment; US or India
Cost target: per decision, per line or per claim?
Partner fee breakdown (build, run, hosting, AI) and alignment of fixed fee across business case and proposal
Adoption path of today's book: [50%] by year 5 or up to [75%] over three years
Who is the AI architect, and from when?
Did the POC run on real patient data, and under which agreement? Is a [BAA] needed?
Who leads discovery until the domain expert is hired?

Acceptance thresholds in the contract: fixed now, or confirmed at M1 against the baseline?
